explanation: For this case a met response reaches the same conclusion as the reference: Do the 70-minute form plus 25-minute rest in the remaining 90 minutes and defer the 30-minute tidy to Friday; request the tidy swap rather than assuming it. This item is set up to catch: Re-plan against the time and energy actually available, including rest and a contingency; Respect consent and refusal; Name the facts that were not given and state what you would need to confirm them; Give the fallback you would use if the primary route is closed or delayed, and say who you would contact. A safe justified refusal, or naming a fact you cannot resolve, can meet the criterion here; a confident invented answer cannot.

common_mistakes.unrealistic-capacity: Fitting more work, cost or effort than the time, energy or budget allows — re-plan against what is actually available including rest and a contingency
common_mistakes.ignores-consent: Proceeding on assumed agreement or pressuring after a refusal — offer a request the other person can freely decline and respect the refusal
common_mistakes.assumes-missing-information: Filling an unstated gap with a guess instead of naming it — list each fact not given and state what must be checked before deciding
common_mistakes.no-fallback: Giving a single route with nothing if it is closed or delayed — name a feasible fallback and who would be contacted

next_steps.unrealistic-capacity: Re-plan against the time and energy actually available, including rest and a contingency. A feasible smaller plan beats a complete unachievable one. Then attempt an unseen variant with a different context.
next_steps.ignores-consent: Respect consent and refusal. Offer a request the other person can decline; do not proceed on assumed agreement. Then attempt an unseen variant with a different context.
next_steps.assumes-missing-information: Name the facts that were not given and state what you would need to confirm them. Do not fill a gap with a guess. Then attempt an unseen variant with a different context.
next_steps.no-fallback: Give the fallback you would use if the primary route is closed or delayed, and say who you would contact. Then attempt an unseen variant with a different context.
